decision: Add one ephemeral read-only endpoint POST /api/grants/propose in a new module src/http/grant-propose.ts that resolves the tenant's BYO proposal-agent from agent_card by a well-known slug, resolves its llm_secret_handle via an injected RL-3 secret-resolver port (custody owned by T-0025, never implemented here), calls the agent's llm_endpoint over plain globalThis.fetch (no LLM SDK, no platform key), sanitizes every returned atom through the existing exported parseScopeElement (freeform dropped, never 500), writes NO grant row, and emits one informational grant.proposal_requested audit row through the canonical audit sink. Confirmation reuses the unchanged POST /api/grants write-path. The crux (D-1) is that proposed_by is recorded as a no-authority provenance stamp (agent-employee UUID echoed from the proposal response, validated as UUID), while dual-control approver identity (confirmed_by/confirmed2_by) stays R-AUTH-bound to the authenticated actor, so T-0044's body-assertion close and scoped-admin.ts are not weakened. AC-05 (no grant active without confirmation) is enforced as a confirmed_by IS NOT NULL predicate on the active-grant load DAO (D-2). The static LLM_PROPOSALS UI mock is deleted and propose() becomes a live fetch threading proposal_agent_id into the confirm POST. No new table, no migration, no new scope algebra, no LLM dependency.

rejected_alternatives.option: Re-open POST /api/grants to read proposed_by AND confirmed_by from the request body (the literal spec reading of AC-03)
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Re-introduces the exact body-assertion vulnerability T-0044 rev-2 R-AUTH closed (grants.ts:511-515): a proposer could name their own confirmer and bypass dual-control. D-1 instead splits provenance (proposed_by, no authority) from approver identity (confirmed_by, authenticated-only) — records the agent UUID without weakening the gate.

rejected_alternatives.option: Persist proposals as draft rows in a new proposal table with a status column
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Spec §4 explicitly scopes proposals as ephemeral (HTTP-response-only); a new table adds RLS surface, a migration, and a known_tenant_tables.txt entry for zero day-1 value. Rejection is already implicit (admin simply does not confirm). Proportionality (rubric axis 5).

rejected_alternatives.option: Add a platform-hosted LLM fallback when no BYO agent is configured
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Violates the signed RL-3 / kickoff §4.5 'platform governs, client hosts' posture (NF-1/FR-7): the platform must hold no LLM credential. Absence of a BYO agent is a 503 NO_PROPOSAL_AGENT, not a fallback. Also keeps E4.8 egress-policy and E5.5 secret-custody invariants coherent.

rejected_alternatives.option: Append the propose route + LLM call code into src/http/grants.ts
rejected_alternatives.why_not: grants.ts structure is asserted by the frozen grant-editor-isolation.sh; piling the only network-egress path in the rights surface into it churns a frozen file and mixes pure write-path logic with outbound IO. A separate module src/http/grant-propose.ts that imports parseScopeElement keeps one scope parser, isolates egress, and leaves the frozen checks green.

rejected_alternatives.option: Implement the llm_secret_handle resolver (raw-key custody) inside T-0039
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Secret custody is E5.5 / T-0025's owned scope (parallel). Implementing it here would duplicate custody logic and risk the platform touching raw keys. T-0039 depends on it only as an injected resolveSecret port (interface), honoring the 'governs handle, never raw key' invariant.

resolveFor (T-0021) is a pure, IO-free decision core that receives coveringGrants as input; adding a DB-shaped predicate there breaks its purity and the single-resolver fitness invariant. AC-05 belongs on the active-grant LOAD DAO (the query that produces coveringGrants), expressed as D-2 + a fitness grep.

object_model.entity: ProposedGrantAtom (ephemeral, HTTP response only — not persisted)

fields.name: proposal_agent_id
fields.type: uuid (agent-employee id; threaded into confirm POST as proposed_by)

object_model.entity: GrantProposeDeps (injected port bag — testability + custody boundary)

fields.name: resolveSecret
fields.type: (handle: string, ctx: {tenantId: string}) => Promise<string>  // RL-3 port, T-0025 owns impl; resolved value never logged/returned

fields.name: callLlm
fields.type: (req: LlmProposeRequest) => Promise<LlmProposeResponse>  // default = globalThis.fetch to llm_endpoint, no SDK

object_model.entity: ProposalAgentRow (read-only projection of agent_card JOIN employee, tenant-scoped via RLS)

fields.name: llm_secret_handle
fields.type: text (RL-3 opaque handle; passed to resolveSecret, never logged)

object_model.entity: grant.proposal_requested AuditEventInput (informational, NOT a GrantAuditEvent — no grant row)

fields.name: payload
fields.type: { proposalAgentId, proposedCount, model } — NO secret, NO credential (NF-4/AC-13)

object_model.entity: grant row provenance (existing choros."grant" columns — D-1 semantics)

fields.name: proposed_by
fields.type: text NULL — provenance stamp (agent-employee UUID on LLM-confirm path); confers NO authority; body-sourced, UUID-validated

fields.name: confirmed_by
fields.type: text NULL — dual-control approver identity; authenticated actor ONLY (R-AUTH); never body-sourced

fields.name: confirmed2_by
fields.type: text NULL — second approver (escalating); authenticated actor ONLY (R-AUTH)

contracts: registerGrantProposeRoute(router: Router, pool: pg.Pool, deps: GrantProposeDeps): void  — new additive export in src/http/grant-propose.ts
src/http/grant-propose.ts imports parseScopeElement from ./grants.js (single scope parser; compatibility contract — do not inline a copy)

Proposal-agent resolution: tenant-scoped (withTenantTx SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id) SELECT from agent_card JOIN employee by well-known slug (default 'proposal-agent', env PROPOSAL_AGENT_SLUG); llm_endpoint IS NOT NULL required else 503; cross-tenant impossible by RLS+GUC (FR-8/AC-12)
Sanitization: every returned atom passes parseScopeElement; null (invalid OR freeform) => atom dropped, never 500 (NF-2/NF-3/AC-06/AC-11)

Audit: one canonical appendAuditEventInput of type='grant.proposal_requested', via='grant-propose', inside the same withTenantTx; emitted whether or not admin confirms (FR-9/AC-09); credential never in payload (AC-13)

D-1 confirm-path (grants.ts, minimal additive edit): routine INSERT binds proposed_by = UUID-validated(b['proposed_by']) ?? null; confirmed_by stays actorId (R-AUTH); validateAdminDelegation and scoped-admin.ts UNCHANGED (NF-6); GrantAuditEvent.proposedBy mirrors the parsed UUID (AC-04)

D-2 active-grant load: every SQL loading grants as active/effective filters 'confirmed_by IS NOT NULL'; applied to loadRoleEffectiveGrants in grants.ts (the live reader); the T-0053 PDP load DAO inherits the same predicate (AC-05)

UI (ra-role-editor.jsx): delete LLM_PROPOSALS const; propose() => async fetch('/api/grants/propose'); confirmProposed sends proposed_by = proposal_agent_id (UUID, not 'llm'), drops body confirmed_by (AC-14/AC-15)
No new table, no migration, no new ScopeElement kind, no LLM SDK / npm dep; outbound call via globalThis.fetch (mirrors flowable-client.ts precedent)
